🌙✨ NEW JERSEY EID SHOPPING EXHIBITION 2027! ✨🌙

ZN Fashions is excited to bring you an exclusive EID Shopping Exhibition in NEW JERSEY! 🛍️💖

Get ready for an amazing day of shopping as we bring together a wonderful selection of vendors offering the latest South Asian fashion, traditional clothing, stunning jewelry, accessories, and so much more—all under one roof!

🌟 EVENT DETAILS 🌟

📅 Sunday, March 7, 2027

⏰ 11:00 AM – 8:00 PM

📍 Delta Hotels

515 US Highway 1 South, Iselin, NJ 08830

🛍️ WHAT TO EXPECT:

✨ Beautiful Pakistani & Indian Designer Outfits

✨ Elegant Formal, Casual & Traditional Wear

✨ Gorgeous Jewelry & Accessories

✨ Latest Fashion Trends & Unique Collections

✨ A Variety of Vendors & Exclusive Shopping Finds

Whether you're searching for the perfect Eid outfit, exploring the latest festive collections, shopping for beautiful jewelry and accessories, or finding something special for your loved ones, this is your one-stop destination for all your Eid shopping needs! 🌙✨

💖 SHOP • EXPLORE • SUPPORT SMALL BUSINESSES 💖

Bring your family and friends and enjoy a day filled with fashion, shopping, and beautiful collections from talented vendors!

📣 VENDORS WANTED!

Interested in showcasing your products at our NEW JERSEY exhibition? Contact us for vendor opportunities and booth information.

📞 For Vendor Inquiries & Event Information:

630-776-9407

🌐 www.znfashions.com to register and book your booth!

❤️ Mark your calendars, invite your friends, and share this event!

We can't wait to see you in NEW JERSEY!
